case_summary: Our neighbor, Rudy Hinson, is placing large piles of dirt across from our driveway in an access easement. This is unsightly and will affect the future sale of our property. It also affects our ability to easily get in and out of our driveway.
key_facts: Rudy Hinson is the neighbor placing dirt piles.
The dirt piles are located in an access easement.
The piles are affecting the ability to access the driveway.
The desired outcome is the removal of the dirt piles and maintenance of the access easement.
